title: CVE-2026-134056 — An out-of-bounds write issue exists in padded block cipher decryption in AWS-LC
summary:
An out-of-bounds write issue exists in padded block cipher decryption in AWS-LC. It affects applications that decrypt CBC or ECB ciphertext with PKCS7 padding over multiple calls into the minimum documented output buffer. A remote user who supplies crafted ciphertext might crash the application or corrupt adjacent memory. Affected are all versions of AWS-LC before 5.7.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 4.x before 4.2.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 3.x before 3.6.0, and AWS-LC-FIPS 2.x before 2.0.18.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to AWS-LC 5.7.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 4.2.0, or AWS-LC-FIPS 3.6.0.

title: CVE-2026-101862 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 0669a36, contains a path traversal vulnerability in the survey import function that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to execute arbitrary code on the server. The POST /noform/management/importSurvey endpoint trusts archive entry names when SurveyExportHelper writes imported files through FileService, so a crafted survey archive can write a JSP file outside the survey storage directory into the application directory, where Tomcat executes it with the privileges of the EUSurvey process
title_vi: CVE-2026-101862 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101863 — EUSurvey 1
summary: EUSurvey 1.5.5 through 1.6, prior to commit d5295d5, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /forms/bulkchange endpoint that allows any authenticated user to take over or delete other users' surveys. SurveyController accepts arbitrary survey IDs and privilege values, and BulkExecutor applies the requested access-right changes or deletion without checking whether the requester can manage those surveys, allowing an ordinary ROLE_USER account to grant itself full control of another user's survey, read its draft and results, edit the form, manage its invitations, or delete it.

title: CVE-2026-101864 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit a4161a9, contains a weak password recovery mechanism that allows attackers who obtain a still-valid password-reset link to take over accounts that use a local EUSurvey password. The /auth/reset/ flow checks only the age of a reset code and does not invalidate it after the password is changed, and issuing a newer link leaves earlier links active, so a used or superseded link remains valid for up to 24 hours from issuance and can be reused to set a new password, sign in as the affected user, and lock that user out.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101864 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101866 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 118facd, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public POST /runner/draft/runner endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite another participant's saved draft and obtain its private invitation token. The draft save handler in RunnerController and AnswerService loads an existing draft by invitation alone without checking that the submitted survey, participation group and invitation belong together, then replaces the draft's answers, reassigns it to the submitted survey, and returns a resume link containing the private invitati
title_vi: CVE-2026-101866 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101867 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit edb5021, contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the GET /settings/shareEdit/{shareId} and POST /settings/shares handlers that allows any authenticated user to read or modify another user's contact share. The ownership check in SettingsController denies access only when a condition is both true and false, so it never denies access, allowing an ordinary account without Contact Management privileges to read the names and email addresses in a share and to rename it, change its recipient or access mode, or replace its contacts.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101867 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101868 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 4bf95a3, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the GET /preparepublishedcontribution/{id} endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to read private responses submitted to published surveys. The contribution PDF handler in ContributionController looks up a response by its sequential database ID and skips the normal response access checks, so attackers can enumerate IDs to retrieve other respondents' answers, including free-text answers that may contain personal data, across surveys.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101868 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101869 — EUSurvey 1
summary: EUSurvey 1.4.4.6738 through 1.6, prior to commit de1145c, contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the public results page GET /publication/{shortname} that allows unauthenticated attackers to infer non-public response data. ReportingService builds a SQL column expression from part of a user-supplied filter parameter name and inserts it directly into the query, so a visitor to any survey that publishes its results can inject boolean conditions and use the presence or absence of public result rows to infer private reporting data, including response data and respondent metadata from other surv

title: CVE-2026-101870 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit de1145c, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public POST /editcontribution/{code} endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite another respondent's submitted answers. The handler in ContributionController selects the survey and answer set from body parameters by numeric contribution ID and never checks that the private edit code in the URL matches that contribution, so an attacker who knows a contribution ID can replace its saved answers without the respondent's edit link.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101870 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101871 — EUSurvey 1
summary: EUSurvey 1.5.2 through 1.6, prior to commit ffd5da7, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the public POST /runner/delphiUpdate endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit responses to Delphi surveys after the owner has closed them. DelphiController checks only that the survey exists and is a Delphi survey and skips the closure check enforced by the normal survey page, so an attacker who knows the survey and question IDs can create new responses that remain in the survey's results.

title: CVE-2026-101872 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 4bf95a3, contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the GET /dashboard/surveys endpoint that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to infer data from the main application database. SurveyService inserts unrecognized sort values directly into the ORDER BY clause of a native query, so attackers can supply SQL expressions and use response timing to infer any data readable by the application's database account, including data outside the surveys listed on their dashboard.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101872 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101873 — EUSurvey 1
summary: EUSurvey 1.5.2 through 1.6, prior to commit bb7432c, contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Delphi survey explanations that allows survey participants to execute arbitrary JavaScript in other users' browsers. Explanations submitted to POST /runner/delphiUpdate are stored by AnswerExplanationService without sanitization and rendered as HTML in delphiAnswersTable.jsp, so an injected event handler runs in the EUSurvey origin with the session of any participant or survey manager who views the answers table.

title: CVE-2026-101874 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 6db6147, contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the GET /exports/checkNew endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to read the names of other users' finished exports and suppress their notifications. ExportsController trusts a user ID supplied by the browser without checking it against the authenticated session, and ExportService marks every export it returns as notified, so the owner never receives the notice that their export is ready.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101874 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101876 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 03cc974, contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in PDF export that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to make the server send HTTP or HTTPS requests to internal services. Question titles saved through POST /{shortname}/management/edit are rendered as raw markup in runnercontentinnerpdf.jsp, and the PDFRenderer resource loader fetches referenced images without checking whether the destination is on an internal network when a response is exported as a PDF.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101876 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-101877 — EUSurvey through 1
summary: EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 4ff1ba0, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET /pdf/survey/{surveyId} endpoint that allows attackers holding a valid invitation for one survey to download a different survey's restricted questionnaire PDF without signing in. PDFController checks that the supplied invitation and participation group are active but not that they belong to the requested survey, exposing questions intended only for invited respondents of any published survey that allows PDF access.
title_vi: CVE-2026-101877 — EUSurvey đến phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-122090 — Pelican 4
summary: Pelican 4.12.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in pelican-import. An attacker-controlled wp:post_name from a WordPress XML export is used in an output filename that is interpolated into a Pandoc command passed to subprocess.call with shell=True. On POSIX systems, command substitution in the slug is evaluated when a user imports the crafted export.

title: CVE-2026-130166 — n8n is an open source workflow automation platform
summary: n8n is an open source workflow automation platform. Prior to 1.123.90 and 2.14.0, the invitation acceptance endpoint accepts inviter and invitee user IDs without a signed invitation token, allowing any preexisting member to take over a pending new user account. A member with permission to list users can read the ID of a pending account and set its password without authentication, then log in as that user, including as an admin when the invitation has the admin role. Exploitation requires an invitation that has not been accepted yet. This issue is fixed in versions 1.123.90 and 2.14.0.

title: CVE-2026-130167 — n8n is an open source workflow automation platform
summary: n8n is an open source workflow automation platform. Prior to 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2, the password reset link and role change operations do not protect the instance owner account from users with a custom instance role. A user whose custom instance role includes user management permissions can obtain a password reset link for the owner and take over the owner account, or change the owner's role, gaining full control of the instance. Exploitation requires the custom roles feature and a custom instance role with user management permissions. This issue is fixed in versions 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.

title: CVE-2026-130169 — AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents
summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.26 through 0.7.4, AutoGPT Platform ships a publicly known, hardcoded default JWT verification key in backend/.env.default and autogpt_platform/.env.default. Because HS256 is symmetric, anyone who knows the secret can forge valid JWTs for any user or for the admin role, bypassing authentication and authorization without user interaction. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.

title: CVE-2026-132257 — AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents

title: CVE-2026-133930 — A pooled-buffer lifetime error in Elasticsearch ES|QL Arrow response formatting can disclose data from other users' concurrent requests
summary: A pooled-buffer lifetime error in Elasticsearch ES|QL Arrow response formatting can disclose data from other users' concurrent requests. An authenticated user with read access to an index who requests Arrow output containing an affected column type can receive data from indices they are not authorized to access. A temporary block can be released to a shared memory pool before deferred response writers finish using it, allowing concurrent requests to reuse the same memory. The attacker cannot select which concurrent data is disclosed.

title: CVE-2026-135416 — A vulnerability has been found in D-Link DIR-600L 2
summary: A vulnerability has been found in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. Affected by this vulnerability is the function hedwigcgi_main of the file hedwig.cgi. The manipulation leads to missing authentication. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

title: CVE-2026-124851 — An information disclosure vulnerability in Zstandard versions 1
summary: An information disclosure vulnerability in Zstandard versions 1.5.1 through 1.5.7 allows specially crafted compressed data to expose the contents of an internal buffer through decompressed output. The buffer is 64 KiB in the default configuration and may contain uninitialized memory or literals from earlier decompressions performed using the same decompression context. An attacker who can submit compressed data and observe the resulting output can recover the buffer's contents.

title: CVE-2026-132270 — AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents
summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, AutoPilot prices block calls using model-supplied input but executes them with the server-resolved credential. Supplying a syntactically valid placeholder credential causes the price rule to evaluate to zero, skipping both the balance check and debit while still running paid blocks on the operator's credential. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, chat and prompt text passed to the Claude Code CLI is pre-processed before reaching the model, bypassing AutoPilot's tool allow-list and PreToolUse hooks. title: CVE-2026-135419 — A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Airline Reservation System 1
summary: A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Airline Reservation System 1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file admin/navbar.php. This manipulation of the argument page causes cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

title: CVE-2026-135684 — SparkyFitness before 1
summary: SparkyFitness before 1.12.0 contains a missing ownership check in getNutritionixHeaders that allows authenticated users to use another user's Nutritionix API credentials via the providerId parameter. Attackers who know a victim's provider UUID can call the Nutritionix search, nutrients, item, or exercise endpoints to consume the victim's paid API quota.

title: CVE-2026-135685 — SparkyFitness before 1
summary: SparkyFitness before 1.12.0 contains a weak password change vulnerability that allows attackers with a victim's session to change the account password without supplying the current password. Attackers can send a POST request with only newPassword to /api/identity/update-password to lock out the legitimate owner and retain persistent access.

title: CVE-2026-135686 — Trilium through 0
summary: Trilium through 0.107.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in updateNormalEntity() that allows malicious sync partners to inject SQL by supplying crafted entity names and column keys. Attackers can abuse /api/sync/changed or PUT /api/sync/update data to copy sessions, etapi_tokens and user_data into synced rows and write arbitrary database rows.

title: CVE-2026-135687 — Arcane before 3
summary: Arcane before 3.0.0 fails to enforce the requiresPasswordChange account flag on the server, allowing attackers with initial or temporary credentials to obtain fully privileged access tokens. Attackers can log in via /api/auth/login and call privileged endpoints such as POST /api/users to create users without completing the mandated password change.

title: CVE-2026-135688 — Idno through 1
summary: Idno through 1.6.4 contains an unauthenticated blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in the /webmention/ endpoint that fetches attacker-supplied source URLs without scheme, host, or IP validation. Attackers can set target to a local page and source to loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata addresses, then infer internal service reachability from response status and timing.

title: CVE-2026-135689 — Community Store for Concrete CMS before 2
summary: Community Store for Concrete CMS before 2.8.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via the order email in single_pages/dashboard/store/orders.php. Attackers can place guest orders with quoted email local parts containing markup to execute script in a store manager's session when viewing the order.

title: CVE-2026-135690 — CivetWeb through 1
summary: CivetWeb through 1.16 built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in hpack_decode() in src/http2.inl. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a crafted HEADERS frame ending with a Huffman-coded string over TLS-negotiated HTTP/2 to read one byte past the heap frame buffer.

title: CVE-2026-135691 — Open5GS WebUI through 2
summary: Open5GS WebUI through 2.8.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in webui/server/routes/db.js that allows authenticated user-role accounts to modify the Account model. Attackers can send PATCH /api/db/Account/<username> setting roles to admin, overwrite password hashes, delete accounts, and read hashes to gain full administrative control.

title: CVE-2026-135692 — rConfig Core 8
summary: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a PHP object injection vulnerability in app/Casts/EncryptStringCast.php that unserializes decrypted attributes without class restrictions. Authenticated attackers can store a serialized gadget chain in encrypted fields like device passwords, triggering command execution as the web server user when read via GET /api/devices.

title: CVE-2026-135693 — rConfig Core 8
summary: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Config Search View Matches dialog, which renders configuration context via v-html without escaping. Attackers can place markup in device banners, interface descriptions, ACL remarks or SNMP locations to execute script in a user's session and read stored configurations containing secrets.

title: CVE-2026-135694 — rConfig Core 8
summary: rConfig Core 8.1.0 before 8.2.20 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in ExportController.php that allows authenticated users to export restricted tables. Attackers can supply excluded table names to export($table), bypassing the EXCLUDED_TABLES deny list, and obtain decrypted passwords, device credentials, and API tokens.

title: CVE-2026-135695 — rConfig Core 8
summary: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.13 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the users API that allows authenticated users to modify other accounts. Attackers can send a UserController::update request with an administrator's user id and new password, then log in as that administrator to take full control.

title: CVE-2026-135696 — rConfig Core 8
summary: rConfig Core 8.2.19 before 8.2.22 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass the DeviceIpIsValid loopback guard by supplying unresolved hostnames. Attackers can create a device with a hostname resolving to loopback and device_port_override 6379, causing configuration downloads to send Redis inline commands for remote code execution.

title: CVE-2026-135697 — CleverReach WP before 1
summary: CleverReach WP before 1.5.28 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Article_Search controller that allows unauthenticated attackers to read non-public posts by supplying post IDs. Attackers can enumerate the id parameter in search requests to retrieve raw content of draft, pending, private, and password-protected posts and pages.

summary: OS command injection in the a3cli restricted shell in Lantronix S2220 Series 2 allows an authenticated attacker to bypass shell restrictions and execute arbitrary operating system commands via unsanitized command substitution metacharacters, including backticks and $(), in parameters of permitted commands over SSH. summary:
Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization and Use After Free in certain ASUS router models allows an unauthenticated nearby user to cause the service to write unexpected values or crash the system under specific timing conditions.

title: CVE-2026-77918 — Gogs through 0
summary: Gogs through 0.14.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to view private forks by querying fork listings without per-fork read checks. Attackers with read access to a private base repository can call GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/forks or the Forks web handler to obtain other users' private fork owners, names, descriptions and clone URLs.

summary: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in certain ASUS routers allows an unauthenticated nearby user to corrupt process memory, potentially resulting in a denial-of-service, via crafted LLTD packets.Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

That returns a code reference for any fully qualified function name, Perl builtins in the CORE namespace included. The digest function is called on the canonical form of the referenced element, so the document picks both the function and its argument.

title: CVE-2026-135703 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory use vulnerability in asfrtp_parse_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_asf.c that allows malicious RTP sources to leak heap contents by supplying an oversized ASF packet length. Attackers controlling an RTSP server with an x-asf-pf payload can set len_off beyond the RTP payload so the ASF demuxer returns stale heap memory as demuxed media data.

title: CVE-2026-135704 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the MXG demuxer's mxg_read_packet() that allows attackers to leak uninitialized heap memory through truncated marker segments. Attackers can supply a crafted MXG file ending in a truncated APP13 segment with a large declared length, causing uninitialized heap contents to be emitted as audio packet payload, for example into remuxed output files.

title: CVE-2026-135705 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a stack out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ff_h264_parse_framesize() in libavformat/rtpdec_h264.c when parsing an SDP a=framesize attribute lacking a height. Attackers controlling an RTSP server DESCRIBE response or a crafted .sdp file can make atoi() read past the line buffer, crashing clients or parsing stale stack bytes.

title: CVE-2026-135706 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in modplug_read_header() in libavformat/libmodplug.c that allocates the buffer using max_size instead of sz. When max_size is set to 0, attackers can supply crafted module files that avio_read() copies into a zero-sized buffer, causing memory corruption, crashes, or possible code execution.

title: CVE-2026-135707 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory vulnerability in nist_read_header() in libavformat/nistspheredec.c, where an inverted ff_alloc_extradata() return check leaves the embedded-shorten extradata byte uninitialized. Attackers can supply a crafted NIST SPHERE file declaring pcm,embedded-shorten coding to leak an uninitialized heap byte into copied output or trigger a NULL pointer write on allocation failure.

title: CVE-2026-135708 — FFmpeg 8
summary: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 contains an improper URL scheme validation vulnerability in the WHIP muxer that allows malicious WHIP servers to create or truncate local files via the Location header. Attackers can return a file: URL that dispose_session() opens read-write with truncation on teardown, destroying arbitrary user-writable files or redirecting requests to other protocols.

title: CVE-2026-135709 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in ogg_buffer_data() in libavformat/oggenc.c because ogg_buffer_page() leaves a full page current after failed allocation. When page allocation fails, a memset with length (size_t)-1 or an overflowing memcpy writes past the segment table, causing heap memory corruption and crashes when writing Ogg output.

title: CVE-2026-135710 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in vmd_read_packet() in libavformat/sierravmd.c that leaves 16 packet bytes unwritten for Indeo3 frames. Attackers can supply a crafted VMD file with Indeo3 video to expose leftover heap contents in demuxed packets, such as stream-copied output files.

title: CVE-2026-135711 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an XML injection vulnerability in ttml_write_header() in libavformat/ttmlenc.c that writes stream language metadata unescaped into the xml:lang attribute. Attackers can supply media files, such as Matroska subtitle tracks with crafted Language values, to inject markup into converted TTML documents and alter downstream parsing or rendering.

title: CVE-2026-135712 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the split_planes size check of write_packet() in libavformat/img2enc.c that allows out-of-bounds heap reads. Attackers can supply a crafted input whose rawvideo stream declares very large width and height, remuxed into .y image files, to leak heap memory into output files or crash the application.

title: CVE-2026-135713 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in libavformat/mmst.c that allows malicious MMS servers to crash clients by sending malformed ASF headers. Attackers can send an ASF header lacking a packet size or stream properties, causing mms_open() to return success after freeing state and crash on first read.

title: CVE-2026-135714 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in amf_get_field_value2() in libavformat/rtmppkt.c that NUL-terminates truncated AMF strings at the declared length instead of bytes read. A malicious RTMP server, or connecting client in listen mode, can send truncated onStatus or _error strings to leak uninitialized stack memory through log messages.

title: CVE-2026-135715 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the AVIF muxer in libavformat/movenc.c that allows attackers to crash the application through streams with unknown pixel formats. Attackers can supply a crafted input whose video stream is stream-copied to AVIF, causing unchecked av_pix_fmt_desc_get() results to be dereferenced, resulting in denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-135716 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in build_frame_code() in libavformat/nutenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt the header_len[] array by supplying inputs with many audio streams. Attackers can remux a crafted input with many audio streams to NUT, causing out-of-bounds reads past static header tables and crashing the application.

title: CVE-2026-135717 — FFmpeg 8
summary: FFmpeg 8.0 before 9.1 contains a use of uninitialized memory vulnerability in opus_parse_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_opus.c that reads the Opus TOC byte from stale buffer memory when parsing empty RTP payloads. A malicious RTSP server or RTP sender can deliver an empty Opus payload to cause incorrect packet durations and leak bits of stale memory through pkt->duration.

title: CVE-2026-135718 — FFmpeg 7
summary: FFmpeg 7.0 before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dvdvideo_audio_stream_add_all() in libavformat/dvdvideodec.c when parsing menu audio streams. Attackers can supply a crafted DVD image whose menu IFO declares more than 8 audio streams, reading past the audio_control array and crashing applications.

title: CVE-2026-135719 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in dxa_read_packet() in libavformat/dxa.c that ignores short avio_read() results for CMAP palette data. Attackers can supply a crafted DXA stream over a stalling network source so uninitialized stack bytes are copied into returned video packets and decoded frames.

title: CVE-2026-135720 — FFmpeg 9
summary: FFmpeg 9.0 before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in dash_read_header() in libavformat/dashdec.c when building LCEVC stream groups without checking for a missing codecs string. Attackers can supply a crafted MPD manifest with a representation declaring a dependencyId but no codecs attribute to crash applications using the DASH demuxer.

title: CVE-2026-135721 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in ff_rtp_send_vc2hq() in libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that accepts a Dirac next parse offset of zero. Attackers can supply crafted Dirac/VC-2 video remuxed to the RTP muxer, causing the parsing pointer to never advance and consume CPU indefinitely.

title: CVE-2026-135722 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in peak_init_writer() and wav_write_packet() in libavformat/wavenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying audio with zero channels. Attackers can provide a crafted PCM stream declaring no channels for WAV output with peak envelope enabled, causing out-of-bounds writes past peak_maxpos and peak_maxneg arrays, crashes, and potential code execution.

title: CVE-2026-135723 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a double free vulnerability in the fill_marker() function of libavformat/imf_cpl.c that frees a Marker label without clearing the pointer when default scope allocation fails. Attackers can supply a crafted Composition Playlist with a Marker Label lacking a scope attribute, triggering a second free in imf_marker_free() under memory pressure and causing memory corruption or a crash.

title: CVE-2026-135724 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in avformat_stream_group_create() in libavformat/options.c that sets the group type before allocating parameters. Attackers can supply crafted HEIF/AVIF files whose tile grid parsing under allocation failure makes ff_free_stream_group() dereference a NULL tile_grid, crashing the application.

title: CVE-2026-135725 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ff_rtmp_packet_write() in libavformat/rtmppkt.c that allows malicious RTMP servers to overflow a 16-byte header buffer. Attackers can send a Set Chunk Size packet on a high channel id with an extended timestamp, which handle_chunk_size() echoes back, corrupting the publishing client's stack.

title: CVE-2026-135726 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rdt_parse_packet() in libavformat/rdt.c that allows remote attackers to crash applications by omitting the ASMRuleBook SDP attribute. Attackers can serve an RTSP session selecting RDT transport without ASMRuleBook, then send an RDT data packet to crash ffmpeg or ffprobe.

title: CVE-2026-135727 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in rfc4175_handle_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_rfc4175.c that leaks heap contents into decoded video frames. Attackers can send RTP streams containing only some scan lines of a frame, leaving av_malloc buffer bytes uninitialized and exposing process heap memory in displayed, stored or re-streamed video.

title: CVE-2026-135728 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a signed integer overflow vulnerability in libavformat/dashdec.c that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a crafted DASH manifest. Attackers can craft an MPD manifest with very long BaseURL and SegmentTemplate strings to overflow max_url_size, causing undersized URL allocations and denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-135729 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an XML injection vulnerability in write_adaptation_set() in libavformat/webmdashenc.c that writes stream language metadata unescaped into the AdaptationSet lang attribute. Attackers can supply crafted WebM files whose track language contains quotes or angle brackets to inject attributes or elements, controlling segment URLs and representations in generated MPD manifests.

title: CVE-2026-135730 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory vulnerability in vpk_read_header() in libavformat/vpk.c that computes a last block size not divisible by the channel count. Attackers can supply a crafted VPK file with a large channel count so the last audio packet exposes leftover heap memory contents.

title: CVE-2026-135731 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an integer overflow in send_picture() of libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that leaves the bit reader without a buffer, causing a NULL pointer dereference. Attackers can supply a Dirac/VC-2 stream with a picture data unit of about 256 MiB or more to crash applications packetizing it to RTP.

title: CVE-2026-135732 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in mxf_write_d10_audio_packet() in libavformat/mxfenc.c because mxf_init() accepts unsupported D-10 audio codecs. Attackers can supply a crafted input with a non-PCM multichannel audio stream remuxed to D-10 MXF to leak heap memory into the output file or crash the application.

title: CVE-2026-135733 — FFmpeg through 9
summary: FFmpeg through 9.1 contains an insecure default configuration in the zmq and azmq filters of libavfilter/f_zmq.c that binds an unauthenticated command socket to all interfaces on TCP port 5555. Remote attackers can send 'TARGET COMMAND [ARG]' messages passed to avfilter_graph_send_command() to change filter runtime parameters and alter processed audio or video.

title: CVE-2026-135734 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the deflicker filter that lets attackers corrupt heap memory via unclamped high bit depth luma samples. Attackers can supply crafted video whose luma values exceed the nominal depth, making calc_avgy16() increment counters past the histogram allocation, causing crashes or possibly code execution.

title: CVE-2026-135735 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in filter_slice_rgba_planar() that allows attackers to read beyond lookup tables using unmasked high bit depth planar samples. Attackers can supply crafted video with samples exceeding the nominal depth, passed unchanged by rawvideo, to crash the application or leak heap contents into output video.

title: CVE-2026-135736 — FFmpeg 4
summary: FFmpeg 4.4 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_deband.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a runtime coupling command. Attackers can send a 'deband coupling 1' command via sendcmd or an unauthenticated zmq filter, making chroma planes be processed at luma dimensions to crash the process or potentially execute code.

title: CVE-2026-135737 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write and read vulnerability in the tmidequalizer filter that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal maximum. Attackers can craft planar 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit video so compute_histogram16() and apply_contrast_change16() index unclamped samples, crashing applications, corrupting the heap, and leaking heap contents.

title: CVE-2026-135738 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_signalstats.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal maximum. Attackers can craft planar 9 to 14 bit YUV video whose unclamped samples or saturation values index past histogram ends, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

title: CVE-2026-135739 — FFmpeg 7
summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_scale.c that allows attackers to read past the filter input array by sending width or height commands using ref variables. Attackers can send such commands via sendcmd scripts or unauthenticated zmq or azmq filters, causing config_props() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash the process.

title: CVE-2026-135740 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_readeia608.c because build_histogram() does not clamp high bit depth luma samples to the nominal maximum. Attackers can supply crafted 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit gray or YUV video to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes or possibly code execution.

title: CVE-2026-135741 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_lut2.c because the second input's pixel format is unrestricted when the output depth option is set. Attackers can supply crafted media such as monoblack BMP or PBM images to index beyond lookup tables, crashing applications or leaking heap contents into output video.

title: CVE-2026-135742 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in recv_msg() of the zmq and azmq filters that allows unauthenticated network attackers to corrupt memory by sending oversized command messages. Attackers can send a 4 GiB message to the default listening port, truncating the int buffer size so memcpy() writes past the heap allocation and crashes FFmpeg.

title: CVE-2026-135743 — FFmpeg 4
summary: FFmpeg 4.3 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in the dynaudnorm filter because cqueue_resize() miscalculates gain history queue element counts when gausssize changes at runtime. Attackers can send gausssize commands via asendcmd scripts or an unauthenticated azmq filter to corrupt heap memory, crashing the process or potentially executing code.

title: CVE-2026-135744 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the lut1d filter in libavfilter/vf_lut3d.c that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying planar high bit depth samples above the nominal depth. Attackers can craft 9, 10, 12 or 14 bit planar RGB video processed with a large 1D LUT to crash applications or disclose heap contents in output pixels.

title: CVE-2026-135745 — FFmpeg before 9
summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the curves filter in libavfilter/vf_curves.c that allows attackers to read past lookup tables by supplying planar high bit depth samples exceeding the nominal depth. Attackers can craft video files with unmasked gbrp9 to gbrp14 samples passed through the rawvideo decoder to crash applications or leak heap contents into output video.

When writing an encrypted parquet file with a column with bloom filters, the header and bitsets of the bloom filter are written in plaintext in the final parquet.



Users are recommended to upgrade to versions 57.3.3, 58.4.2, 59.3.3 or 60.2.0 which fix the issue by raising an error when trying to write encrypted parquet files with bloom filters enabled, preventing such files from being written out.

For this attack to be successful, the following must be true

  *  The attacker has obtained credentials for a user account with zk-read permission (which is recommended assigned to trusted admi

title: CVE-2026-86312 — Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check
summary:
Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check. In deployments that rely on Solr's rule-based authorization, a client granted only the low-privilege health permission could thereby trigger behavior that should require higher privileges; where the shipped security.json template leaves the health permission unauthenticated, no credentials are required at all. 


This issue affects Apache Solr from 9.0.0 through the releases preceding the fixed versions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.11.0 or 10.1.0, which resolve the issue.

title: CVE-2026-133229 — Improper authentication in the emergency login in Devolutions Server 2026
summary: Improper authentication in the emergency login in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an attacker who holds an administrator emergency code to create multiple persistent administrator sessions via replay of the single-use code on the scripting login endpoint.

title: CVE-2026-133230 — Improper access control in the PAM provider endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026
summary: Improper access control in the PAM provider endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an authenticated non-administrator PAM user to read provider configuration metadata via a missing permission check on the provider details route.

title: CVE-2026-133231 — Stored cross-site scripting in the documentation editor in Devolutions Server 2026
summary: Stored cross-site scripting in the documentation editor in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with documentation write access to execute script in another user's session via an unencoded image caption parameter.

title: CVE-2026-133232 — Improper access control in the repository access request endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026
summary: Improper access control in the repository access request endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an authenticated low-privileged user to self-approve an access request via an out-of-range vault type value that skips the approval check.

title: CVE-2026-133249 — Improper access control in the access request approval endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026
summary: Improper access control in the access request approval endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an authenticated low-privileged user to self-approve a credential access request via a client-controlled parent request identifier.

title: CVE-2026-135154 — Tolgee before 3
summary: Tolgee before 3.242.5 fails to enforce email verification on the TOTP enable and recovery-code regeneration endpoints, allowing attackers to enroll MFA on unverified accounts via the @BypassEmailVerification annotation. Attackers can register with a victim's email, enroll an attacker-controlled TOTP factor through PUT /v2/user/mfa/totp, and permanently lock the legitimate owner out after verification and password reset.

title: CVE-2026-135155 — PodFetch 5
summary: PodFetch 5.2.0 before 5.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Audiobookshelf-compatible POST /api/podcasts endpoint that allows authenticated low-privilege users to add podcasts by bypassing role and USER_PODCAST_LIMIT checks. Attackers with the plain user role can submit attacker-chosen feed URLs in media.metadata.feedUrl to force server-side fetching and episode downloads, consuming disk and bandwidth.

title: CVE-2026-135156 — The weDevs Subscribe2 WordPress plugin 10
summary: The weDevs Subscribe2 WordPress plugin 10.35 before 10.50 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remove public subscribers by forging the s2_unsub GET parameter. Attackers can base64-encode a known subscriber email and visit any page with the subscribe2 shortcode to delete that subscriber from the mailing list.

title: CVE-2026-135157 — Future AGI before 1
summary: Future AGI before 1.51.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ACSView.post that allows authenticated members of any organization to take over accounts in other organizations by asserting arbitrary e-mail addresses. Attackers can register a controlled identity provider through IDPUploadViews to obtain sessions as cross-tenant users, and can modify or delete other organizations' identity-provider configurations.

title: CVE-2026-135158 — Windmill 1
summary: Windmill 1.607.0 before 1.819.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace members to resume or cancel suspended flows in other workspaces by abusing the jobs_u/resume and jobs_u/cancel endpoints. Attackers can mint a resume signature for an arbitrary job id via their own workspace's job_signature endpoint to approve or cancel another workspace's suspended flow steps.

title: CVE-2026-135159 — Windmill 1
summary: Windmill 1.664.0 before 1.819.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows any workspace member to mint resume signatures for suspended jobs via create_job_signature, get_resume_urls and get_wac_approval_urls handlers. Members with any role, including operator, can obtain valid HMAC-signed resume URLs to approve flow steps despite self_approval_disabled or user_groups_required restrictions.

title: CVE-2026-135160 — Medplum server 5
summary: Medplum server 5.1.4 before 5.1.42 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Binary $presigned-url operation that allows non-admin project members to overwrite other projects' Binary content. Attackers in a project linked to another project can request a signed upload URL with upload=true for a readable Binary and overwrite its stored content, since project ownership is never verified.

title: CVE-2026-135161 — Interstellar before 6
summary: Interstellar before 6.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by enabling allow_loopback_ips and allow_private_ips in wisp-js at startup. Attackers can open a wisp WebSocket that bypasses the Express password middleware and create TCP streams to loopback, internal hosts, or cloud metadata services.

title: CVE-2026-135162 — Sim 0
summary: Sim 0.5.61 before 0.9.41 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows write-level workspace members to change workflow MCP server visibility without admin permission. Attackers can set isPublic via POST or PATCH to /api/mcp/workflow-servers, exposing deployed workflows to unauthenticated invocation through /api/mcp/serve.

title: CVE-2026-135163 — Okou API before 1
summary: Okou API before 1.762.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in its Microsoft Teams, legacy Slack, and GitHub App integration OAuth flows that trusts caller-supplied userId and orgId values. Unauthenticated attackers who know a member's identifiers can complete the flow with their own external account to bind that identity or installation to the victim's Okou user and organization.

title: CVE-2026-135164 — Formance Ledger 2
summary: Formance Ledger 2.2.0-beta.3 before 2.4.18 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote API callers to execute SQL by supplying unvalidated account expand values. Attackers can inject comment-separated SQL through the expand query parameter or base64 pagination cursor to run queries with the ledger database role's privileges.

title: CVE-2026-135165 — CISO Assistant before 4
summary: CISO Assistant before 4.2.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to block all logins by exhausting a shared rate limit keyed on the frontend server IP. Attackers can send a low sustained rate of failed login attempts through the SvelteKit frontend to exhaust the django-allauth per-address budget, locking out every user.

title: CVE-2026-135166 — Umbraco CMS 17
summary: Umbraco CMS 17.4.0 before 17.8.2 and 18.0.0 before 18.3.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because MemberValueSetBuilder.GetValueSets writes sensitive member properties into the Examine members index. Backoffice users with Settings and Members access but outside the Sensitive data group can search the index via the Examine Management dashboard or Management API to read hidden sensitive member values.

title: CVE-2026-135167 — LibRaw 0
summary: LibRaw 0.22.0 through 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in HuffTable::len() because parse_dht() stores Huffman DC symbols without validating them as difference categories. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF/ARW file with oversized Huffman symbols in a Sony YCbCr lossless JPEG stream to crash applications decoding it, causing denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-135168 — msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3
summary: msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0, when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE, contains an out-of-bounds heap read in x3_parse.hpp due to assuming contiguous input. Attackers can supply msgpack str, bin or ext values unpacked from non-contiguous containers like std::deque, causing memcpy past storage blocks and disclosing adjacent heap memory.

title: CVE-2026-135169 — msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3
summary: msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the Boost.X3 parser in include/msgpack/v2/x3_parse.hpp when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE in reference mode. Attackers can supply crafted msgpack input parsed over buffering iterators so decoded str, bin and ext objects hold dangling pointers, disclosing freed heap memory or crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-135170 — Wing FTP Server before 8
summary: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a Lua code injection vulnerability that allows LDAP-authenticated users to inject Lua statements into session files via unescaped login names. Attackers can log in with a name containing a Lua long-string terminator followed by code, which executes on a later session request as the Wing FTP service account.

title: CVE-2026-135171 — Wing FTP Server before 8
summary: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a predictable session identifier vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack administrator sessions by deriving identifiers from process, time, ServerID, and client IP state. Attackers can enumerate candidate identifiers using the service_get_license.html endpoint as a validity oracle and replay live sessions to gain administrative control including the Lua console.

title: CVE-2026-135172 — Question2Answer through 1
summary: Question2Answer through 1.8.8 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the qa-include/ajax/version.php admin version-check handler that allows authenticated administrators to make the server send arbitrary HTTP GET requests. Attackers can supply a loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata address in the uri POST parameter with isCore=true to read internal service responses returned in the Ajax output.

title: CVE-2026-135173 — PdfPig through 0
summary: PdfPig through 0.1.16 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted PDF documents with self-referencing AcroForm /Kids or deeply nested marked content. Attackers can trigger an uncatchable StackOverflowException in AcroFormFactory.GetAcroField or Page.GetOptionalContentsRecursively, terminating any process reading form fields or optional content.

title: CVE-2026-135174 — Softaculous Virtualizor before 3
summary: Softaculous Virtualizor before 3.2.9 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in enduser/auth_callback.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication via OAuth-returned email addresses. Attackers can register an OAuth provider account with an email containing SQL syntax to complete social login as the administrator account.

title: CVE-2026-135175 — ZITADEL 4
summary: ZITADEL 4.19.5 before 4.20.3 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect notification links by placing a trusted host in the userinfo portion of the x-zitadel-public-host header. Attackers knowing a victim's login name can harvest single-use codes from password-reset links sent to their host, reset passwords, and take over accounts including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-135176 — LibRaw 0
summary: LibRaw 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in LibRaw::xtrans_interpolate() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted X-Trans raw files. When wavelet denoising threshold or chromatic aberration correction is enabled, the destimage buffer is sized from halved iwidth/iheight but indexed at full width, causing writes of file-derived pixel values beyond the allocation and crashes.

title: CVE-2026-135177 — LibRaw through 0
summary: LibRaw through 0.22.3 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in LibRaw::pentax_4shot_load_raw() that allows attackers to crash applications by scanning tiff_ifd[] beyond its 10 entries. Attackers can supply a crafted four-frame Pentax DNG with too few IFDs matching the raw dimensions to cause denial of service when LIBRAW_RAWOPTIONS_PENTAX_PS_ALLFRAMES is enabled.

title: CVE-2026-60076 — Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB
summary:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Unbounded in-memory materialization in REST fastLastQuery cache-hit path enables heap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 2.0.5 before 2.0.12.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-60077 — Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB
summary:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated REST clients can bypass row-limit cap to triggerheap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 before 2.0.12.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-60078 — Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB
summary:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated Grafana clients can bypass row-limit cap to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-60079 — Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB
summary:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated REST clients can insert large payload to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

title: CVE-2026-101220 — Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4
summary: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

title: CVE-2026-103782 — Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4
summary: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Argument Injection vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and unauthorized access to filesystem resources.

title: CVE-2026-107784 — On Windows, the tarfile "tar" and "data" extraction filters did not reject member names or link targets that have a drive but no root, such as "C:foo"
summary: On Windows, the tarfile "tar" and "data" extraction filters did not reject member names or link targets that have a drive but no root, such as "C:foo". When extracting to a relative destination, such a member was written to the current working directory of that drive instead of the destination, and a symbolic link with such a target pointed outside the destination. The filters now refuse these member names and link targets with AbsolutePathError and AbsoluteLinkError.

title: CVE-2026-129975 — A flaw was found in gpgme
summary: A flaw was found in gpgme. When processing crafted input, an early return following memory reallocation can leave internal buffer pointers referencing previously freed memory, resulting in a double-free condition during cleanup. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to corrupt process memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or a Denial of Service (DoS) crash.

title: CVE-2026-132779 — When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1
summary:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%.

Impact:
System performance can degrade until the NGINX worker process is either forced to restart or is manually restarted. This vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a deg

title: CVE-2026-133632 — In astro-airflow-mcp 0
summary: In astro-airflow-mcp 0.5.0 through 0.9.1, the af CLI and the MCP server send telemetry from a Python subprocess that can import modules from the current working directory. If a user runs an af command or an MCP tool call from inside a project that contains an attacker-supplied json.py, that file runs with the user's privileges. Users who only run the tool in projects they trust are not affected. Fixed in 0.9.2; in earlier versions, setting AF_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 prevents it.

title: CVE-2026-134465 — In mcp-server-git before 2026
summary: In mcp-server-git before 2026.10.28, the --repository restriction can be bypassed through a nested directory that contains a .git file with a gitdir pointer to a repository outside the allowed path. A caller who can invoke the server's tools, place such a file in the allowed tree, and knows the outside repository's path can read committed content from that repository and create branches in it.

title: CVE-2026-134492 — In mcp-server-fetch from 2026
summary: In mcp-server-fetch from 2026.10.10 and before 2026.11.11, the check that blocks requests to non-public addresses treats IPv6 site-local addresses (fec0::/10) as public. A fetch to such an address passes the server-side request forgery guard. Practical impact is limited because many hosts have no route to this range.

title: CVE-2026-135078 — A vulnerability has been found in KeudellCoding User Location Map up to 1
summary: A vulnerability has been found in KeudellCoding User Location Map up to 1.2.5. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file resources/humhub.usermap.js of the component MapView Widget. The manipulation of the argument displayname leads to cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.0 addresses this issue. The identifier of the patch is c49a5fcdb289808378836c19d4da199913798a50. The affected component should be upgraded.

title: CVE-2026-135206 — ToDesktop Builder before 0
summary: ToDesktop Builder before 0.36.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the todesktop-fs custom protocol handler that allows attackers to escape the bundled files directory using ../ sequences. Attackers who can run script in an application's renderer can issue XMLHttpRequest calls with traversal paths to read arbitrary files accessible to the user.

title: CVE-2026-135207 — Healthchecks before 4
summary: Healthchecks before 4.4 contains a verification bypass vulnerability that allows project users to mark arbitrary email addresses as verified because Channel.make_token() omits the email address. Attackers can verify an address they control, change the integration to a victim address, then reuse the original link to send unsolicited alert emails.

title: CVE-2026-135208 — Kerberos Agent before 3
summary: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.

title: CVE-2026-135209 — ServerOS Panel before 1
summary: ServerOS Panel before 1.10.1 contains a decompression bomb vulnerability in DeploySourcePacker::extract() that allows authenticated users with manage-machines permission to bypass the 4 GB unpacked-size limit by under-declaring zip entry sizes. Attackers can upload a crafted archive via POST /machines/{machine}/sources whose entries inflate far beyond declared sizes, filling the host disk and denying service to all workspaces.

title: CVE-2026-135210 — Plane before 1
summary: Plane before 1.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in WorkspaceDraftIssueViewSet that allows authenticated workspace members to create drafts in unauthorized projects by supplying an arbitrary project_id. Attackers can convert drafts into work items in private or removed-from projects with chosen title, state, assignees, cycle_id and module_ids, triggering notifications and disclosing project membership.

title: CVE-2026-135211 — BISHENG before 3
summary: BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v2/workflow/invoke and /api/v2/workflow/stop routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to run workflows as the administrator. Attackers knowing a workflow UUID can supply an override replacing a Code node's code parameter with Python passed to exec(), achieving remote code execution, or stop other users' workflow sessions.

title: CVE-2026-135212 — AiSOC before 23
summary: AiSOC before 23.6.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the agents service that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' investigation runs by supplying their run_id. Attackers can query GET /api/v1/investigations/{run_id}, report variants, the WebSocket stream, or agent-runs routes to obtain audit logs, forensic output, and incident reports.

title: CVE-2026-135213 — Worklenz before 3
summary: Worklenz before 3.4.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /api/v1/activity-logs/:id that allows authenticated users to read other teams' task activity logs because it lacks the verifyTaskAccess middleware. Attackers who know another team's task UUID can retrieve reporter and assignee names and avatars plus the full timeline of status, priority, label and estimation changes.

MISP accepted compressed HTTP request bodies (gzip, brotli, zstd) and decompressed them before authentication was performed, with no limit on the size of the resulting decompressed data. An unauthenticated attacker could send a small compressed payload that expands to a very large decompressed body, exhausting server memory and causing a denial of service. Brotli and zstd, with their high compression ratios, made the attack particularly effective.

The StartupMessage is a list of NUL-terminated strings, so a NUL in the database name, user, currentSchema, options or ApplicationName adds further parameters. %00 in a URL decodes to a NUL. Someone who controls part of the URL or a property can choose another login role or add replication=database, although the connection still has to pass the authentication of that role. On a server that trusts the client, the attacker can log in as any role. All versions before 42.7.15 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes

title: CVE-2026-135271 — In JetBrains Kotlinx
summary: In JetBrains Kotlinx.serialization before 1.12.0 a DoS attack was possible via recursive JSON decoding

title: CVE-2026-135272 — In JetBrains Kotlinx-io before 0
summary: In JetBrains Kotlinx-io before 0.9.3 information disclosure was possible via partial file writes on Node.js

title: CVE-2026-135286 — phpwcms before 1
summary: phpwcms before 1.9.53, 1.12.7 and 2.0.0-beta.4 contains a host header poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to control password reminder links by sending a forged X-Forwarded-Host header. Attackers can submit the public password reminder form for a victim so the emailed {LOGIN_URL} points to an attacker host, capturing the new password when the victim logs in there.

title: CVE-2026-135287 — LiteLLM Proxy 1
summary: LiteLLM Proxy 1.62.4 before 1.84.0 contains a callback injection vulnerability that allows authenticated API key holders to register process-wide logging callbacks by supplying callbacks fields in request bodies. Attackers can name an unenabled observability integration such as langsmith or langfuse to leak all users' prompts and responses, or suppress operator logging via litellm_disabled_callbacks.

title: CVE-2026-135288 — AIOStreams 2
summary: AIOStreams 2.9.0 through 2.38.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in makeRequest() that leaks the internal secret header by matching URLs against INTERNAL_URL using a string-prefix check. Attackers can supply a custom addon manifest URL or redirect to a prefix-matching host or port to capture the secret and directly call internal addon routes.

title: CVE-2026-135289 — ERPSaaS 3
summary: ERPSaaS 3.7.9 through 3.47.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated company users to inject script markup through unescaped client and company address fields. Attackers can store script in address lines rendered by getFormattedAddressHtml() via unescaped Blade output, executing in browsers of users viewing, previewing or printing invoices and estimates.

title: CVE-2026-135290 — OpenCV through 4
summary: OpenCV through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in YAMLParser::parse that allows attackers to cause denial of service via crafted YAML dash lines. Attackers can supply YAML files with a non-separator '-' line after the first document, opened through cv::FileStorage, to hang the thread at full CPU.

title: CVE-2026-135291 — Contiki-NG through 5
summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rpl_remove_routes_by_nexthop() in the RPL-Classic implementation that allows adjacent attackers to crash nodes. Attackers participating in the RPL network can create a stale route whose next-hop neighbor entry was removed, then trigger parent removal to crash the node.

title: CVE-2026-135292 — Contiki-NG through 5
summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the MPL multicast engine that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to corrupt memory via unchecked seed ID lengths. Attackers can send near-maximum-size MPL messages with an S=3 option in a short hop-by-hop header, causing data_message_expiration() to write 16 bytes past uip_buf and crash the node.

title: CVE-2026-135293 — Contiki-NG through 5
summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icmp_in() in os/net/ipv6/multicast/mpl.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to hang nodes via crafted MPL control messages. Attackers on the same link can send an MPL data message to create a seed entry, then an all-zero bit vector control message causing index wraparound and denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-135294 — LibreCAD through 2
summary: LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in RS_FilterDXF1::readFileInBuffer() caused by unvalidated truncation of the 64-bit file size. Attackers can persuade users to open a crafted DXF file sized 0xFFFFFFF8 bytes, writing a NUL byte before an 8-byte buffer to corrupt heap metadata and crash the application.

title: CVE-2026-135295 — FontForge through 20251009 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PcfReadEncodingsNames() that allows attackers to corrupt memory via ne
summary: FontForge through 20251009 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PcfReadEncodingsNames() that allows attackers to corrupt memory via negative glyph indices from truncated PCF encodings tables. Attackers can supply a crafted .pcf file imported through the GUI or scripting Import() command to write before the encs array, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: CVE-2026-135296 — LibreCAD through 2
summary: LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains an out-of-bounds access vulnerability in picPunto::processFilePic() of the PIC import plugin that allows attackers to read past QStringList bounds via coordinate tokens lacking commas. Attackers can persuade a user to import a crafted PIC file with malformed line, circle, box or text records to crash the application and potentially modify memory.

title: CVE-2026-135297 — Convoy before 26
summary: Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated dashboard users to read other organisations' data due to missing membership checks on /ui/organisations/{orgID}/ read routes. Attackers who know another organisation's ID can request members, invites/pending, and projects endpoints to obtain member emails, roles, pending invitee emails, and project lists.

title: CVE-2026-135298 — Convoy before 26
summary: Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in /portal-api single-resource handlers that allows portal link token holders to access other tenants' resources by ID. Attackers with another tenant's resource IDs in the same project can read endpoint signing secrets and webhook payloads, rotate secrets, pause or delete endpoints, and force event re-delivery.

title: CVE-2026-135299 — Convoy before 26
summary: Convoy before 26.3.7 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows any project API key holder, including viewer-scoped keys, to read host files via require() in JavaScript transform functions. Attackers can submit a function to the sources/test_function endpoint calling require on a file path to disclose configuration files containing database credentials and secrets.

title: CVE-2026-135300 — Pomerium from 0
summary: Pomerium from 0.30.0 before 0.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the MCP token endpoint that skips client secret verification for client_secret_basic clients. Attackers holding an intercepted authorization code or refresh token can redeem it at /.pomerium/mcp/token with any secret to obtain the victim's access tokens.

title: CVE-2026-134010 — odf-kit is a TypeScript and JavaScript library for working with OpenDocument Format files
summary: odf-kit is a TypeScript and JavaScript library for working with OpenDocument Format files. In versions 0.9.8 through 0.14.1, the odsToHtml() renderer inserts document-controlled cell formatting and row height values into HTML style attributes without escaping them. An attacker can craft an ODS file that injects arbitrary HTML attributes or elements, allowing JavaScript execution in the host page's origin when an application inserts the converted output as HTML. This issue is fixed in version 0.14.2.
