title: CVE-2026-135428 — Automura for Gravity Forms – Webhooks & REST API for Automation before 1
summary: Automura for Gravity Forms – Webhooks & REST API for Automation before 1.0.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in Rest_Admin::serve_file() on the global rest_pre_serve_request filter. Unauthenticated attackers can craft REST links setting automura_gf_file to script HTML and automura_gf_file_type to text/html, executing JavaScript with a victim administrator's session.

title: CVE-2026-135429 — Tabbycat 2
summary: Tabbycat 2.9.0 through 2.12.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in TournamentViewSet that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain write access because PerTournamentPermissionRequired returns True for views lacking a tournament attribute. Attackers can send POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE requests to /api/v1/tournaments to create, modify or delete tournaments, cascading deletion to teams and speakers.

title: CVE-2026-135430 — KindleEar 3
summary: KindleEar 3.0.0 through 3.5.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in application/view/subscribe.py that allows authenticated users to access other users' records by id without ownership checks. Attackers can enumerate sequential recipe ids to read recipe source containing credentials, delete recipes and custom RSS feeds, and overwrite saved site logins.

title: CVE-2026-135431 — MyBibliotheca 3
summary: MyBibliotheca 3.0.0 before 3.0.4 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify or delete other users' books via /api/v1/books/<book_id>. Attackers can obtain book UUIDs from recently added books across all owners, then send PUT or DELETE requests to rename, alter, or permanently delete them.

title: CVE-2026-135432 — sdcb Chats 1
summary: sdcb Chats 1.10.0 before 1.17.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in GetAssignedUserDetails that allows assigned non-admin users to read other users' per-user MCP headers. Attackers can request the assigned-user-details endpoint to obtain bearer tokens in CustomHeaders and impersonate other users against the downstream MCP server.

title: CVE-2026-135433 — FLTK through 1
summary: FLTK through 1.4.5 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in Fl_BMP_Image::load_bmp_() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying crafted BMP or ICO files. Attackers can specify very large image dimensions so the 32-bit row and alpha mask pointer offsets wrap, writing file-derived pixel bytes out of bounds to crash applications or possibly execute code.

title: CVE-2026-135434 — django-appointment before 3
summary: django-appointment before 3.14.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated staff members to modify other staff members' appointments by supplying arbitrary appointment IDs. Attackers can send POST requests to /ajax/update_appt_date_time/ with sequential appointment_id values to reschedule appointments, rewriting date, start and end times and reminders.

title: CVE-2026-135435 — Daptin before 0
summary: Daptin before 0.13.61 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to overwrite restricted contacts by sending CardDAV PUT requests to existing contacts. Attackers holding address book Update permission can bypass per-contact row permissions in PutAddressObject to modify protected contacts and confirm their existence.

title: CVE-2026-135436 — KindleEar 3
summary: KindleEar 3.0.0 through 3.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to run Python code by uploading malicious recipes. Attackers can submit crafted recipe source to the /recipe/upload action, which calibre compile_recipe executes via exec() without sandboxing, gaining root code execution in the Docker container and access to password hashes.

title: CVE-2026-135437 — Firefly Pico through 1
summary: Firefly Pico through 1.12.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to overwrite other users' profiles by supplying arbitrary profile IDs. Attackers with an access token can send another user's sequential ID to the ProfileController update method, reassigning the profile and destroying the victim's saved settings.

title: CVE-2026-135438 — Anchr before 3
summary: Anchr before 3.7.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to host HTML files by uploading them through the image upload feature with a spoofed image content type. Attackers can upload an .html file served via GET /api/image/:id from the Anchr origin, running script that steals the victim's localStorage session token for account takeover.

title: CVE-2026-135439 — Fusion through 1
summary: Fusion through 1.3.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass private-address protection by submitting URLs to the POST /api/feeds/validate endpoint. Attackers can supply a public URL that redirects or links to loopback, private, or link-local addresses, making feedfinder request internal services and leak parsed titles in responses.

title: CVE-2026-135440 — MediaInfoLib before 26
summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in the Vorbis setup header parser that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed memory via crafted files. Attackers can supply a crafted Ogg/Vorbis file that makes File_Vorbis::Setup() return early without BS_End_LE(), leaving a stale bitstream pointer that causes crashes or heap disclosure.

title: CVE-2026-135441 — MediaInfoLib before 26
summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an uninitialized pointer dereference vulnerability because the File_Mpeg4_Descriptors constructor leaves the IsCmaf pointer holding stale heap contents. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with an AAC/USAC decoder specific descriptor so File_Usac::Streams_Finish_Conformance_Profile dereferences an invalid address, crashing the application.

title: CVE-2026-135442 — MediaInfoLib before 26
summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Visual parser that allows attackers to read global memory via an uninitialized frame_rate_code index into Mpegv_frame_rate. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file that forces stream finalization before parser synchronization, crashing the process or leaking adjacent memory into the reported frame rate.

title: CVE-2026-135443 — MediaInfoLib before 26
summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the VC-1 parser that uses uninitialized AspectRatio, profile and colordiff_format members as unchecked table indices. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file that finalizes the VC-1 stream before synchronization, crashing the process and potentially exposing adjacent memory in reported metadata.

title: CVE-2026-135444 — MediaInfoLib before 26
summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpegv::Streams_Fill() that allows attackers to read adjacent memory via an uninitialized chroma_format index. Attackers can craft media files that reach Streams_Fill() before Synched_Init(), crashing MediaInfo or embedding applications and possibly exposing static memory in parser output.

title: CVE-2026-135445 — MediaInfoLib before 26
summary: MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability in TimeCode::FromString() that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying hour-unit timestamps with fewer than three fractional digits. Attackers can craft a TTML file whose begin or end attribute contains such a timestamp, causing MediaInfo or embedding applications to crash with SIGFPE when opened.

title: CVE-2026-135446 — Bold pagos en linea WordPress plugin before 3
summary: Bold pagos en linea WordPress plugin before 3.5.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in the bold_co webhook that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge payment notifications. Attackers can set metadata.reference to begin with 'test' and sign the body with the empty test_secret_key HMAC, marking any unpaid WooCommerce order as paid.

summary:

summary:

title: CVE-2026-102952 — The Zephyr TFTP client in subsys/net/lib/tftp/tftp_client
summary:
The Zephyr TFTP client in subsys/net/lib/tftp/tftp_client.c does not check where the reply to its request comes from. After sending a read or write request to the configured server, send_request() accepts the first UDP datagram that arrives on the client's socket from any address and port. It then calls zsock_connect() to that sender, so the sender becomes the peer for the rest of the transfer. summary:

title: CVE-2026-135089 — A vulnerability was found in humhub questions up to 1
summary: A vulnerability was found in humhub questions up to 1.1.5. Affected is an unknown function of the file widgets/views/answer.php of the component QA Module. Upgrading to version 1.1.6 is able to address this issue. The patch is named cdc39878ba457ca71271c1ec3cf05fe025e3e9fc. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

title: CVE-2026-135090 — A vulnerability was determined in humhub lets-meet up to 1
summary: A vulnerability was determined in humhub lets-meet up to 1.2.1. Affected by this vulnerability is the function NewInviteNotification::html of the file notifications/NewInviteNotification.php of the component Notification Rendering. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 1.2.2 addresses this issue. This patch is called 6c82534ffcb90e74229671a76caef1a8285c5190. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

title: CVE-2026-135091 — A security flaw has been discovered in humhub rest up to 0
summary: A security flaw has been discovered in humhub rest up to 0.12.6. This affects an unknown part of the file views/admin/bearer-auth.php of the component Bearer Token Administration Page. summary: A potential security vulnerability has been identified in the HP Hotkey UWP Service, which might allow escalation of privilege. HP is releasing mitigation for the potential vulnerability. Customers using HP Programmable Key are recommended to update HP Hotkey Support.

summary: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/redirectAndLogin endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain another user's Meari camera-platform identity and session credentials by supplying that user's uid. The endpoint used the caller-supplied uid to select the Meari account without verifying that it belonged to the account authenticated by the Dreame-Auth token. summary: DreameHome MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to subscribe to another device's status topic /status/{DID}/{UID}/{model}/# without owning or having access to the device. Attackers who know the device DID, owner UID, and model can receive the device's telemetry, including compressed LiDAR map frames exposing the home's layout, the Wi-Fi SSID and BSSID, local IP address, gateway, firmware version, and the session key used for encrypted video.

title: CVE-2026-49962 — DreameHome device sharing and MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows former share recipients to
summary: DreameHome device sharing and MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows former share recipients to keep receiving a device's MQTT status messages after the owner revokes sharing. Revocation removed application access and the device-command API rejected the former recipient, but the broker still accepted subscriptions to the device's status topic using the DID, owner UID, and model exposed during sharing, allowing continued monitoring of the home's map data and device status.

title: CVE-2026-49963 — DreameHome for Android (com
summary: DreameHome for Android (com.dreame.smartlife) before 2.6.4.0 contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability in RnPluginDownloadManager.java that allows network-positioned attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within the application by replacing React Native feature bundles that are only validated against a client-stored MD5 checksum without publisher authentication. Attackers can replace both the downloaded bundle and its corresponding MD5 metadata to run modified code with the application's permissions and access to its bridge APIs.

title: CVE-2026-49964 — DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /dreame-user-iot/token/rtc2 endpoint th
summary: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /dreame-user-iot/token/rtc2 endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain an Agora RTC token for another user's device by supplying its device DID and owner UID. The endpoint issued the token without verifying device ownership, allowing attackers to join the device's live-video channel and publish video under the targeted device's identity.

title: CVE-2026-49965 — DreameHome cloud API before 2026-11-19 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/bindDevice endpo
summary: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-11-19 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/bindDevice endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to reassign another user's camera to their own Dreame account. The endpoint accepted binding requests from accounts that did not own the camera, so an attacker with the camera identifiers could supply their own user identity, become the camera's masterUid, and remove the camera from the owner's device list, denying the owner access through DreameHome.

summary: Langfuse before 4.82.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows organization admins to target internal hosts by setting the GitHub Enterprise SSO baseUrl, which skips outbound-URL validation. Attackers can point baseUrl to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses so user sign-ins trigger server requests carrying stored OAuth client credentials.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134835 — Langfuse trước 4

title: CVE-2026-134836 — Dashy 4
summary: Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.

title: CVE-2026-134837 — Frappe before 15
summary: Frappe before 15.126.0 and 16.x before 16.55.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows Dashboard Manager users to pollute Object.prototype by storing __proto__ keys in Dashboard Chart custom_options. When any user, including administrators, views a dashboard rendering the chart, Object.assign merges attacker properties into Object.prototype, altering Frappe desk client behavior for that session.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134837 — Frappe trước 15

title: CVE-2026-134838 — Weblate before 2026
summary: Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134838 — Weblate trước năm 2026

title: CVE-2026-134839 — Linkwarden before 2
summary: Linkwarden before 2.17.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the archive upload handler that allows collection members with only add permission to modify other users' links. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/v1/archives/<linkId> to replace another user's stored screenshot, PDF, readable, or HTML archive with attacker-supplied content.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134839 — Linkwarden trước 2

title: CVE-2026-134840 — HumHub before 1
summary: HumHub before 1.19.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController actionNewMemberSearch and actionAdminUserSearch, which skip the checkGroupAccess check. A manager of any single group can query admin-user-search and new-member-search with another group's id parameter to enumerate members, including administrators.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134840 — HumHub trước 1

title: CVE-2026-134859 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file processed with normal generation but without aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into generated normals.

title: CVE-2026-134860 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ReadFloat in ColladaLoader.cpp because accessor stride and offset bounds are checked only by ai_assert. Attackers can supply a crafted Collada file whose animation accessor describes more values than its float_array holds to read past the array or dereference null, crashing the importing application.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134860 ​​— Chuyển qua 6

title: CVE-2026-134861 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134861 — Chuyển qua 6

title: CVE-2026-134862 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that uses NORMAL and TEXCOORD accessors without comparing their counts to the POSITION vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with shorter normal or texture coordinate arrays to trigger heap out-of-bounds reads and writes that crash the importing application.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134862 — Chuyển qua 6

title: CVE-2026-134863 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an invalid pointer dereference vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportEmbeddedTextures that derives the texture format hint without checking the strchr result. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with an embedded image mime type lacking a slash to crash the importing application.

title: CVE-2026-134864 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use of uninitialized resource vulnerability in glTFImporter::ImportMeshes that builds TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN faces from unfilled faces. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file whose strip or fan primitives trigger out-of-bounds reads or null pointer dereferences, crashing the importing application.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134864 — Chuyển qua 6

title: CVE-2026-134865 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ColladaParser::CopyVertex that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying primitives lacking a VERTEX input. Attackers can provide a crafted Collada file whose SIZE_MAX per-vertex offset bypasses the release-removed ai_assert check, crashing the importing application.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134865 — Chuyển qua 6

title: CVE-2026-134866 — Assimp 6
summary: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SkipLine that allows attackers to hang parsing by supplying files with '#' comment lines. Attackers can provide crafted OFF, LWS, or MD3 shader files so ReadFile never returns, consuming a CPU core and denying service.

title: CVE-2026-134867 — Assimp through 6
summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in FBXConverter::GetRotationKeyframeList that allows attackers to exhaust memory via unbounded rotation angle differences. Attackers can supply a crafted FBX file of about 111 KB whose keyframe interpolation loop never advances, consuming gigabytes of memory until the importing process is killed.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134867 — Chuyển qua 6

title: CVE-2026-134868 — Assimp through 6
summary:

title: CVE-2026-134748 — Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3
summary: Members WordPress plugin by MemberPress 3.2.28 before 3.3.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to evade Private Site mode via login page exemption. Attackers can request the front-end login path with a pagename query variable to make WordPress render hidden published pages or the full blog index.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134748 — Plugin WordPress dành cho thành viên của MemberPress 3

title: CVE-2026-134749 — MemberPress Members before 3
summary: MemberPress Members before 3.3.1, with the Block Permissions add-on enabled, contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated Author-level users to crash pages by saving a non-string blockPermissionsMessage block attribute. Attackers can store a JSON array in the attribute so wpautop() in get_block_replacement_content() throws a PHP 8 TypeError, causing fatal errors on post, home, search, and REST pages for unauthorized viewers.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134749 — Thành viên MemberPress trước 3 tuổi

title: CVE-2026-134750 — Members WordPress plugin before 3
summary: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read comments on role-restricted posts via the Latest Comments block. Attackers can view pages hosting the block, where get_the_ID() checks the host page and get_comment_excerpt() bypasses filtering, exposing restricted comments, post titles, and links.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134750 — Plugin WordPress dành cho thành viên trước phiên bản 3

title: CVE-2026-134751 — Members WordPress plugin before 3
summary: Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134751 — Plugin WordPress dành cho thành viên trước phiên bản 3

title: CVE-2026-134752 — WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3
summary: WPGSI: Spreadsheet Integration before 3.8.5 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete posts by abusing the delete action in wpgsi_show_view() without nonce verification. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into following a crafted wpgsi-show link with action=delete and an id parameter to delete arbitrary posts or pages.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134752 — WPGSI: Tích hợp bảng tính trước phiên bản 3

title: CVE-2026-134753 — dsniff through 2
summary: dsniff through 2.5a2 contains an integer underflow in decode_sniffer() in decode_sniffer.c that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write past the global obuf buffer. Attackers can send a UDP datagram to port 2001 on a monitored segment with a 4096-byte string, disabling base64_pton bounds checks to corrupt memory and crash dsniff.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134753 — dsniff qua 2

title: CVE-2026-134754 — anacrolix/torrent before 1
summary: anacrolix/torrent before 1.62.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Decoder.readOneValue in bencode/decode.go that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying deeply nested bencode data. Attackers can deliver crafted .torrent files or magnet link metadata with millions of nested lists to cause a fatal stack overflow, or deeply nested v2 file trees to exhaust CPU.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134754 — anacrolix/torrent trước 1

title: CVE-2026-134755 — better-chatbot before 2
summary: better-chatbot before 2.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that lets built-in tools run without user confirmation in Manual tool mode, because src/app/api/chat/route.ts keeps their execute handlers. Attackers can plant prompt-injected documents or web pages that make the HTTP request tool send conversation data to attacker-controlled URLs.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134755 — chatbot tốt hơn trước 2

title: CVE-2026-134756 — Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2
summary: Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2.39.0 before 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability because user-supplied URLs are only syntax-checked by validate.IsURL without resolved address validation. Authenticated users can abuse Git cloning, Helm retrieval, registry ping, or the GitLab proxy to reach loopback, internal, and cloud metadata addresses, probing ports and reading responses.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134756 — Phiên bản cộng đồng Portainer và Phiên bản doanh nghiệp 2

title: CVE-2026-134757 — Anacrolix torrent before 1
summary: Anacrolix torrent before 1.63.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in NewClient within tracker/http/client.go, which unconditionally sets InsecureSkipVerify to true for HTTPS trackers. Attackers able to intercept tracker traffic can impersonate trackers with any certificate, observe info_hash and peer_id values, and return forged peer lists.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134757 — Torrent Anacrolix trước phiên bản 1

title: CVE-2026-134758 — Wfuzz through 3
summary: Wfuzz through 3.1.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows malicious target servers to inject script by returning crafted links written unescaped into HTML reports. When the links script and html printer are used, attacker-supplied href values close the unquoted anchor tag and execute JavaScript when the operator opens the report.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134758 — Wfuzz đến 3

title: CVE-2026-134660 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title_vi: CVE-2026-134660 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134661 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title_vi: CVE-2026-134661 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134662 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that leaves a stale GF_Command pointer in a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer when the buffer element is not properly closed. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file with malformed nesting, causing gf_sg_sfcommand_del() to free the live command, corrupting heap memory and crashing the process.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134662 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134663 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that retains a pointer to a PROTO sub-graph freed by gf_sg_proto_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file imported with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_command() to update the freed graph's referencing_commands list and crash the process.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134663 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134664 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_sensors.c that allows attackers to crash the process via uninitialized sensor nodes. title_vi: CVE-2026-134664 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134665 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory by supplying a crafted XMT file. When xmt_parse_element() replaces an SFNode field child, the freed node stays cached in parser->peeked_nodes and a later DEF lookup passes it to gf_node_get_name(), crashing MP4Box.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134665 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134666 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader because xmt_node_end() frees unattached nodes but leaves them on the parser node stack. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file whose text content makes xmt_text_content() pass the freed node to gf_node_get_tag(), reading freed heap memory and crashing MP4Box.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134666 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134667 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory via over-long object descriptor URL fragments. title_vi: CVE-2026-134667 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134668 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134668 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134669 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() in src/utils/xml_parser.c that lets attackers read past the heap line buffer. title_vi: CVE-2026-134669 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134670 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title_vi: CVE-2026-134670 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134671 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT-A scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted XMT files. title_vi: CVE-2026-134671 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134672 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title_vi: CVE-2026-134672 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134673 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title_vi: CVE-2026-134681 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in scene graph teardown that allows attackers to trigger access to freed memory via crafted scene files. title_vi: CVE-2026-134682 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134684 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title_vi: CVE-2026-134684 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134685 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in load_xmt_done() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that reads freed nodes during XMT parser teardown. title: CVE-2026-134686 — GPAC MP4Box through 26

title: CVE-2026-134687 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c when handling MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with an MFNode field replace command lacking a node value to crash MP4Box, causing denial of service.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134687 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134688 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the BT/XMT context loader that frees an interaction-type decoder-specific descriptor even when UIConfig re-encoding fails. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a BIFSConfig descriptor, causing gf_odf_delete_descriptor() to reuse and free it again, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134688 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134689 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in JSScript_LoadVRML() in src/scenegraph/vrml_js.c that reads unchecked script_text pointers of Script node url entries. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene loading a Script node whose url entry lacks script text, crashing MP4Box and causing denial of service.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134689 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134690 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134690 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134691 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in gf_event_target_get_node() because destroyed node event targets remain in media object lists. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nodes such as InputSensor to trigger freed memory reads during gf_scene_disconnect(), crashing the process or corrupting heap memory.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134691 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134692 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c resolves DEF names without verifying the node belongs to the current scene graph. Attackers can craft an XMT scene reusing a PROTO node across graphs, causing gf_node_unregister() to read freed memory during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134692 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134693 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_create_node() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c when cloning PROTO instances. Attackers can craft an XMT scene declaring more PROTO interface fields than the cloned instance supplies, crashing MP4Box when a user opens the file.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134693 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134694 — Gammapy through 2
summary: Gammapy through 2.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in WcsGeom.from_header() that passes the WCSSHAPE FITS header card to eval(). Attackers can supply a crafted .fits file with a Python expression in WCSSHAPE, executing code as the user who loads it via Map.read().
title_vi: CVE-2026-134694 — Gammapy đến phiên bản 2

title: CVE-2026-134695 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134695 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134696 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del that allows attackers to free PROTOs still owned by another scene command via the GF_SG_PROTO_DELETE handler. Attackers can craft an XMT scene that declares a PROTO in one command and deletes it by ID in another, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory when opened.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134696 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134697 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() that allows attackers to crash the application via indexed field-replace commands lacking a payload. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF_SG_XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.
title_vi: CVE-2026-134697 — GPAC MP4Box đến phiên bản 26

title: CVE-2026-134698 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in ctxload_process() in src/filters/load_bt_xmt.c that casts object descriptor update entries without checking the descriptor tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene placing a different descriptor type in a GF_ODUpdate command, causing gf_list_get() to dereference an invalid pointer and crash MP4Box.

title: CVE-2026-134699 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

title: CVE-2026-134700 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

title: CVE-2026-134701 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

title: CVE-2026-134702 — GPAC MP4Box through 26
summary: GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

title: CVE-2026-134703 — libexpat through 2
summary: libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML_UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

title: CVE-2026-134704 — OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4
summary: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

title: CVE-2026-129794 — The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that th
summary: The EoE fragment reassembly code uses a frame size from the wire as the bound for memcpy into the application receive buffer, without checking that the declared size fits in the actual buffer. A master can write up to 2016 bytes into a buffer the application may have sized much smaller.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129794 — Mã tập hợp lại đoạn EoE sử dụng kích thước khung từ dây làm ràng buộc cho memcpy vào bộ đệm nhận ứng dụng mà không kiểm tra xem

title: CVE-2026-129795 — When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp
summary: When the last EoE fragment has the TIME_APPEND flag set, the handler subtracts 4 from rxframeoffset to strip the timestamp. There is no check that rxframeoffset is at least 4. A fragment carrying fewer than 4 bytes of payload that is also marked LAST causes rxframeoffset to wrap to 0xFFFFFFFC, which is then stored as the buffer length and handed to the TCP/IP stack.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129795 — Khi đoạn EoE cuối cùng được đặt cờ TIME_APPEND, trình xử lý sẽ trừ 4 từ rxframeoffset để loại bỏ dấu thời gian

summary: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129796 — Trình xử lý tải xuống CoE SDO cho các đối tượng có độ dài linh hoạt (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, v.v.) không kiểm tra xem quá trình truyền được khai báo chính

title: CVE-2026-129797 — SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually
summary: SDO_downloadsegment is called whenever a mailbox frame carries the DOWNLOADSEGREQ command byte, regardless of whether a segmented download is actually in progress. ESCvar.data, which the handler writes through, is NULL until a segmented transfer is started. A master can send a DOWNLOADSEGREQ at any time and write through a NULL or stale pointer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129797 — SDO_downloadsegment được gọi bất cứ khi nào khung hộp thư mang byte lệnh DOWNLOADSEGREQ, bất kể tải xuống được phân đoạn có thực sự hay không

title: CVE-2026-129798 — The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in
summary: The CoE SDO segmented download handler advances a write pointer by each incoming segment's size but does not track how many bytes have been written in total. A master can keep sending non-last segments until the pointer has walked past the end of the object buffer or the complete-access staging buffer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129798 — Trình xử lý tải xuống được phân đoạn CoE SDO nâng cấp con trỏ ghi theo kích thước của từng phân đoạn đến nhưng không theo dõi số lượng byte đã được ghi vào

title: CVE-2026-129799 — A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found
summary: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129799 — Yêu cầu CoE SDO cho chỉ mục 0xFFFF khớp với mục nhập trình kết thúc danh sách đối tượng thay vì trả về không tìm thấy

title: CVE-2026-129800 — sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those c
summary: sizeOfPDO, called during state transitions, uses the subindex-0 count of the SM-assign and PDO-mapping objects as loop bounds without checking those counts against the descriptor array sizes. On builds where those subindex-0 values are writable via SDO, a master can write 0xFF and cause sizeOfPDO to read past the end of the descriptor arrays on the next transition to SAFEOP.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129800 — sizeOfPDO, được gọi trong quá trình chuyển đổi trạng thái, sử dụng số lượng chỉ mục con-0 của các đối tượng ánh xạ SM và PDO làm giới hạn vòng lặp mà không kiểm tra các đối tượng đó

title: CVE-2026-129801 — The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite
summary: The FoE DATA frame handler computes the payload length from the master-supplied mailbox length field and passes it directly to FOE_fwrite. The length is checked against the remaining file capacity but not against the physical mailbox buffer size. A master can declare a large length while sending a short frame, causing FOE_fwrite to read past the end of the mailbox buffer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129801 — Trình xử lý khung FoE DATA tính toán độ dài tải trọng từ trường độ dài hộp thư do chính cung cấp và chuyển trực tiếp đến FOE_fwrite

title: CVE-2026-129802 — EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payloa
summary: EOE_set_ip reads each network parameter field (MAC, IP, subnet, gateway, DNS IP, DNS name) from the mailbox payload before checking whether the payload is large enough to contain them. The single bounds check at the end of the function does not prevent the reads from happening. A master can send a Set-IP frame with all flags set and mbxheader.length equal to the minimum, causing all reads to access memory past the end of the payload.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129802 — EOE_set_ip đọc từng trường tham số mạng (MAC, IP, mạng con, cổng, IP DNS, tên DNS) từ tải trọng hộp thư trước khi kiểm tra xem payloa

title: CVE-2026-129803 — The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader
summary: The CoE entry gate accepts frames with mbxheader.length as low as COE_MINIMUM_LENGTH (8), but a normal SDO Download requires at least COE_HEADERSIZE (10) bytes of CoE payload to carry its header fields. With mbxheader.length of 8 or 9, the segmented-transfer branch misevaluates due to unsigned wrap, leaving the declared SDO size unclamped. copy2mbx then reads that many bytes starting past the end of the actual payload and writes them into the object buffer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129803 — Cổng vào CoE chấp nhận các khung có mbxheader

title: CVE-2026-129804 — FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256
summary: FOE_read and FOE_write store the filename length as uint8_t, truncating it modulo 256. When (mbxheader.length - ESC_FOEHSIZE) is a multiple of 256, the length becomes 0. Additionally, a request whose mailbox length equals ESC_FOEHSIZE exactly also produces a length of 0 without any truncation. In both cases FOE_fopen calls strncmp with a length of 0, which always returns equal, so the first registered file whose password is 0 is opened regardless of the filename the master sent.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129804 — FOE_read và FOE_write lưu trữ độ dài tên tệp dưới dạng uint8_t, cắt ngắn nó theo modulo 256

title: CVE-2026-129805 — An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value fie
summary: An object dictionary entry can carry write-access flags and still have a NULL data pointer, for example when a constant value is held in the value field rather than in addressable storage. The CoE SDO download handler checked write access but not whether storage was present, then wrote the master-supplied payload through the NULL pointer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129805 — Một mục từ điển đối tượng có thể mang cờ truy cập ghi và vẫn có con trỏ dữ liệu NULL, ví dụ: khi một giá trị không đổi được giữ trong giá trị fie

title: CVE-2026-129806 — The CoE SDO upload handler enters its normal-response path (used for objects longer than 4 bytes) and passes (objd + nsub)->data directly to the pre-o
summary: The CoE SDO upload handler enters its normal-response path (used for objects longer than 4 bytes) and passes (objd + nsub)->data directly to the pre-object handler and to the response copy. Entries that hold a constant in the value field have data set to NULL; a master can request such an entry and cause a NULL pointer dereference in the upload path.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129806 — Trình xử lý tải lên CoE SDO đi vào đường dẫn phản hồi thông thường (được sử dụng cho các đối tượng dài hơn 4 byte) và truyền (objd + nsub)->dữ liệu trực tiếp đến pre-o

title: CVE-2026-129807 — The FoE file table allows entries to omit a write handler by setting write_function to NULL, making the file read-only
summary: The FoE file table allows entries to omit a write handler by setting write_function to NULL, making the file read-only. FOE_fopen did not check whether write_function was present before accepting a write request; a master sending a WRQ for a read-only file caused a call through a NULL function pointer.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129807 — Bảng tệp FoE cho phép các mục bỏ qua trình xử lý ghi bằng cách đặt write_function thành NULL, làm cho tệp chỉ đọc

title: CVE-2026-129808 — The EoE receive and transmit paths call the handle_recv_buffer and fetch_send_buffer callbacks without first checking whether they are set
summary: The EoE receive and transmit paths call the handle_recv_buffer and fetch_send_buffer callbacks without first checking whether they are set. Both callbacks are documented as optional; an application that omits either one causes a call through a NULL function pointer when the first EoE frame arrives or when the transmit polling loop runs.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129808 — Đường dẫn nhận và truyền EoE gọi các lệnh gọi lại hand_recv_buffer vàfetch_send_buffer mà không kiểm tra trước xem chúng có được đặt hay không

title: CVE-2026-129809 — ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers
summary: ESC_foeprocess can be reached by an incoming mailbox frame before the application calls FOE_config to supply the file table and flush buffer pointers. When foe_cfg or its fbuffer field is NULL the handler dereferenced those pointers while processing the frame, causing a NULL pointer dereference.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129809 — ESC_foeprocess có thể được truy cập bằng khung hộp thư đến trước khi ứng dụng gọi FOE_config để cung cấp bảng tệp và xóa con trỏ bộ đệm

title: CVE-2026-129810 — ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer
summary: ESC_eoeprocess and ESC_eoeprocess_tx can be reached before the application calls EOE_config to supply the callback table pointer. When eoe_cfg is NULL the receive handler dereferenced it while processing an incoming EoE frame, and the transmit polling function dereferenced it on each cycle, causing NULL pointer dereferences.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129810 — Có thể truy cập ESC_eoeprocess và ESC_eoeprocess_tx trước khi ứng dụng gọi EOE_config để cung cấp con trỏ bảng gọi lại

title: CVE-2026-129811 — The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO
summary: The PDO mapping bit lengths stored in the mapping objects are writable by the master via SDO. sizeOfPDO summed them without checking the total against the size of the rxpdo[] or txpdo[] process data buffers. A master can craft a mapping whose total bit count exceeds those buffers, causing COE_pdoPack and COE_pdoUnpack to write past their ends during each process data cycle after the PREOP to SAFEOP transition.

title: CVE-2026-129812 — An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer
summary: An object dictionary entry that holds a constant has no process data storage and carries a NULL data pointer. sizeOfPDO did not check for this when resolving a mapped entry to its descriptor. A master that maps such an entry to a PDO causes COE_pdoPack or COE_pdoUnpack to dereference the NULL data pointer on every process data exchange after the mapping is activated.

title: CVE-2026-129813 — The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry
summary: The CoE complete-access download handler iterated over all subindices of an object and wrote the master-supplied payload into each writable entry. Entries that hold a constant have write-access flags set but carry a NULL data pointer. The handler did not check for this and wrote the master payload through the NULL pointer.

title: CVE-2026-129814 — The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write
summary: The SDO Information Get Object Description and Get Entry Description responses copy the object or entry name into the mailbox data area and then write a null terminator byte. The copy loops ran up to the last available byte in the buffer, leaving no room for the terminator. When an object or entry name exactly fills the available space the terminator is written one byte past the end of the mailbox data buffer.

Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor explains: "I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Chaterm up to 0.12.2 on Windows. The affected element is an unknown function of the file resources/app-update.yml of the component Auto-Update Mechanism. Such manipulation leads to download of code without integrity check. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is described as difficult. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
